$comment: Source of truth for what the public site shows. Only entries listed here appear. 'repos' are local folders under ~/Code, read only for commit counts (no messages, no names). Private repos (the Lab, private back ends) are listed only in the gitignored projects.private.json and summed in without names.

hq.name: Stein&Clankers HQ
hq.blurb: Stein&Clankers is the umbrella over everything we build: one human, a crew of clankers, and a lot of small, carefully made tools. Every building with a logo on its roof is a real project, and the plaza in front of it is that project's real commit history.

projects.name: rrradio
projects.blurb: Internet radio, done properly. One curated catalogue of stations with live now-playing, on the web, iPhone, Apple Watch, CarPlay and Android.

projects.name: Archipelago
projects.blurb: Open-source, local-first enterprise architecture in the browser. ArchiMate 3.2 at its core, a portfolio view on top, and your data never leaves your machine.

projects.name: meinHERMES
projects.blurb: Free, unofficial study site for the HERMES 2022 project-management exam of the Swiss federal administration. Every element links back to the official reference manual.

projects.name: meineSteuer
projects.blurb: A free, neutral guide to Swiss tax law and the tax return for private persons, always pointing back to the official sources.

projects.name: rrrecipe
projects.blurb: A recipe app built around hands-free cooking: tap, swipe or speak to move to the next step when your hands are covered in flour.

projects.name: SteinerDesign
projects.blurb: The design system under all of this: near-white and graphite neutrals, one signal red for what you can act on, structure drawn with 1px lines on a 4px grid.

projects.name: claude-mods
projects.blurb: Mods that run inside Claude Code: live panes, status lines and hooks that make the clankers nicer to work with.

projects.name: squash
projects.blurb: A daily YouTube-news squasher: curated channels go in, one short digest comes out.

cafe.name: Clanker Café
cafe.blurb: The coffee place in the middle of town. If rrradio keeps you company while you work, you can buy it a coffee here: tips go to rrradio through Ko-fi and help keep the stations streaming.

lab.name: The Lab
lab.blurb: Prototypes that aren't ready to show yet. The clankers go in and out all day; what comes out stays behind the shutter for now.
